args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects `Decimal("2.665")` to round to `2.66`, but half-up produced `2.67`.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

## Testing
- `tests/test_money.py` passes locally; CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

Reviewer: @alex
